TablePredicate.title: Table predicate
TablePredicate.description: Recursive non-empty `all`/`any` groups containing groups or conditions; the root cannot be a condition. Limits: 100 members per group, 10 levels, and 500 nodes. The negating operators include nulls and absent cells, multi-select included; combine with `isNotNull` or `isNotEmpty` to exclude them. Pattern operators use `*` as the only wildcard; `%`, `_`, and backslash are literal. Select operators: single-select uses `eq`/`ne`/`in`/`nin`; multi-select uses `contains`/`ncontains`; option names resolve to IDs. Full operand rules are documented on `op`.

oneOf.description: Matches a row when every member matches.

all.description: Members combined with AND. An empty group is rejected, because it would compile to no filter at all.

items.description: A nested group, or a single condition.

field.description: Column name to compare, or one of the system fields `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.

op.description: Operators: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`; `in`/`nin` take arrays; `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty`, `isNull`, and `isNotNull` take no operand. Text operators are `contains`, `ncontains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `like`, `nlike`, `ilike`, and `nilike`. Contains variants are case-insensitive and literal; `like`/`nlike` are case-sensitive, while `ilike`/`nilike` are case-insensitive. `*` is the only wildcard; `%`, `_`, and backslash are literal. For `select` columns, single-select accepts `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `nin`; multi-select accepts `contains`, `ncontains`. Option names resolve to IDs.

value.description: Operand. A scalar for the comparison operators, an array of at most 1000 entries for `in`/`nin`, a pattern for the matching operators, and omitted for `isEmpty`/`isNotEmpty`/`isNull`/`isNotNull`.
